notes: This shared system is added before individual hook lyrix sections.
Individual slow_hook, fast_hook, and hook_nextmove sections still need explicit file lists.
Renderer implementation later should use this as shared hook scheduling data, not as custom per-section renderer code.

hardRules: If fast_hook_blessnow or fast_hook_timeout activates, there is a 5% chance to choose one fast-hook extra.
The valid fast-hook extra choices are fast_hook_bababuda and fast_hook_hums.
fast_hook_badababa_odd.wav is ignored completely.
Do not schedule fast_hook_badababa_odd.wav anywhere.
Parts 3, 5, 7, and 9 each have a 60% chance to be muted.
Each muted part can be replaced by one replacement stem.
Replacement choice is evenly split between valid families.
Part 3 maps to v1 and starts 1 bar into the section.
Part 5 maps to v2 and starts 2 bars into the section.
Part 7 maps to v3 and starts 3 bars into the section.
Part 9 maps to v4 and starts 4 bars into the section.
Part 6 can end the section at 4 bars with 50% chance.
Part 8 can end the section at 5 bars with 50% chance.
Otherwise the section is 6 bars long.

slomoWeedAdlib.weedSectionStartDefinition: counted from when Weed 1 lyrix activates

hardRules: slomo_weed_adlib has a 30% chance to play.
slomo_weed_adlib applies for both Weed 1 and Weed 2.
slomo_weed_adlib can play 8 bars after the Weed section starts.
The Weed section start is counted from when Weed 1 lyrix activates.
floating_weed_adlib has a 50% chance to play.
If floating_weed_adlib plays, remove/mute the matching little bit from Weed 1.
Do not infer missing floating_weed_adlib parts #1 to #5 from the visible #6 filename.
in_adlib_vox_lyrix_odd.wav is not part of normal lyrix section scheduling.
out_adlib_vox_lyrix_even (consolidated).wav is not part of normal lyrix section scheduling.
These files link with breathe vox occasionally.
Handle these through the breathe vox/adlib system, not normal lyrix section scheduling.
